before.name: PTree.Eq.Backend.MathComp.mathcomp_approx_unfold
before.type:
MathComp.mathcomp_approx_unfold
     : forall R : reals.Real.type,
       Kernel.MathCompCouplingGluing R ->
       forall (E : Type -> Type) (A : Type) (n : nat)
         (t : PTreeDefinition.ptreeF E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A
                (PTreeDefinition.ptree E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A)),
       @Kernel.mathcomp_kernel_eq R
         (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A)
         (@PTreeKernel.ptree_hitting_approx E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
            (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R)
            (NativeLaws.MathCompNativeMixedMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R) A n t)
         match t with
         | @PTreeDefinition.RetF _ _ _ _ a =>
             @Kernel.mathcomp_kernel_ret R
               (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A)
               (@UnifiedFrontier.FHRet E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A a)
         | @PTreeDefinition.TauF _ _ _ _ u =>
             match n with
             | 0 =>
                 @Kernel.mathcomp_kernel_zero R
                   (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A)
             | @S m =>
                 @PTreeKernel.ptree_hitting_approx E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
                   (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R)
                   (NativeLaws.MathCompNativeMixedMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R)
                   A m (@PTreeDefinition.observe E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A u)
             end
         | @PTreeDefinition.VisF _ _ _ _ X e k =>
             @Kernel.mathcomp_kernel_ret R
               (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A)
               (@UnifiedFrontier.FHVis E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A X e k)
         | @PTreeDefinition.ProbF _ _ _ _ X mu k =>
             match n with
             | 0 =>
                 @Kernel.mathcomp_kernel_zero R
                   (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A)
             | @S m =>
                 @Kernel.mathcomp_kernel_bind R X
                   (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A) mu
                   (fun x : X =>
                    @PTreeKernel.ptree_hitting_approx E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
                      (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R)
                      (NativeLaws.MathCompNativeMixedMeasure R)
                      (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R) A m
                      (@PTreeDefinition.observe E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A (k x)))
             end
         end
before.assumptions:
Axioms:
boolp.propositional_extensionality : forall P Q : Prop, P <-> Q -> P = Q
boolp.functional_extensionality_dep :
  forall (A : Type) (B : A -> Type) (f g : forall x : A, B x), (forall x : A, f x = g x) -> f = g
boolp.constructive_indefinite_description :
  forall (A : Type) (P : A -> Prop), (exists x : A, P x) -> {x : A | P x}

                  (reals.Real.Exports.reals_Real__to__Num_POrderedZmodule R))) q &&
          @order.Order.le ssrnum.ring_display (reals.Real.Exports.reals_Real__to__Order_POrder R) q

               (ssrnum.Num.NumDomain.Exports.join_Num_NumDomain_between_Order_POrder_and_GRing_SemiRing
                  (reals.Real.Exports.reals_Real__to__Num_NumDomain R)))) ->
       forall (X : Type) (e : E X)
         (k : X -> PTreeDefinition.ptree E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A),
       @MathComp.mathcomp_peutt R G E A
         (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.bind E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) unit A
            (@MathCompPrograms.mathcomp_retry E unit R (@Kernel.mathcomp_bernoulli R q) tt)
            (fun _ : unit =>
             {|
               PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                 @PTreeDefinition.VisF E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A
                   (PTreeDefinition.ptree E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A) X e k
             |}))
         {|
           PTreeDefinition._observe :=
             @PTreeDefinition.VisF E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A
               (PTreeDefinition.ptree E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) A) X e k
         |}
before.assumptions:

  forall (A : Type) (P : A -> Prop), (exists x : A, P x) -> {x : A | P x}
